text.p: Lithuanian newspapers carried the following reports in their Monday editions. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Lithuanian President Algirdas Brazauskas and his Latvian counterpart Guntis Ulmanis have agreed on the need for further negotiations to resolve the maritime border dispute which has soured relations between the two countries.

- Lithuanian economic experts say a surge in demand for dollars in local banks last week was sparked by the Conservative party's post-election pledge to dismantle the currency board and unpeg the litas from the dollar.
- Value added tax will be applied to heating, electricity and fuel from January 1, 1997.

- The Chief Election Committee officially released the results of the first round of the parliamentary elections and named 130 candidates who will participate in the run off in 65 individual constituencies on November 10.
